senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. Elam (Susiana), south of Assyria (v. Schr. KAT2, p. 111).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 42:7">Gen. R. s. 42</cite> <he>ע׳ זה מדי</he> Elam (<cite ref="Genesis 14:1">Gen. XIV, 1</cite>) is Media.
<cite ref="Megillah 18a:12">Meg. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>קראה … ע׳</he> if he read the Book of Esther in Elamitic.—Pl. m. <he>עֵילָמִים</he>.
<cite ref="Megillah 18a:12">Ib.</cite> <he>עילמית לע׳</he> (if he read the Book of Esther) in Elamitic to Elamites.
